overview.description: Cross-platform music player client for Navidrome server via Subsonic API, built with Flutter targeting Android and macOS

key_components.name: SubsonicClient
key_components.description: HTTP client for Subsonic API handling auth, browsing, search, streaming, and starring endpoints

key_components.name: AudioPlayerService
key_components.description: Audio playback engine wrapping just_audio with queue management, shuffle/repeat modes, and play history

key_components.name: NavidromeAudioHandler
key_components.description: audio_service handler integrating system media controls with the audio player

key_components.name: Providers
key_components.description: Riverpod state management layer with 9 provider modules for server config, audio, downloads, theme, library cache, and starred songs

key_components.name: Data Models
key_components.description: Song, Album, Artist, Playlist, Genre, RadioStation domain models mapping Subsonic API responses

key_components.name: AppShell
key_components.description: Root layout with NavigationRail sidebar and MiniPlayer bottom bar, managing screen routing

key_components.name: PlayerScreen
key_components.description: Full-screen player with animated cover art, playback controls, and dynamic gradient background

key_components.name: Library Screens
key_components.description: 7 screens for browsing albums, artists, album-artists, songs, genres, and radio stations

key_components.name: MiniPlayer
key_components.description: Bottom mini playback bar with animated play/pause, cover art hero transitions, and song info

key_components.name: AppTheme
key_components.description: Material 3 theme configuration supporting dark/light modes with external color JSON asset
